input_data_processing.reason: Show consequential preprocessing from raw observations.

validation_robustness.reason: Expose numerical quality and failure boundaries.

global_visual_spec.label_policy: panel letters (a), (b); variables italic; units upright and parenthesized
global_visual_spec.grayscale: Every group remains distinguishable by line style, marker, hatch, boundary, or direct label.
global_visual_spec.accessibility: Colorblind-safe palette; no meaning encoded by color alone; minimum final-size text 7.5 pt.

items.claim_or_question: Exact question answered by this item.
items.expected_reading: One sentence stating what the reader should see.
items.information_gain: Why this visual changes understanding beyond a sentence or table.
items.render_or_table_reason: Why a figure is superior to a table/sentence, or why this item is a table.
prohibited_interpretations: State what this item cannot establish.
